description: Audits operational status of all device interfaces. Counts down/up per device.
sql_query: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_id) AS ls FROM v_interfaces) SELECT device_name, COUNT(*) as total_interfaces, COUNT(CASE WHEN line_status != 'up' OR line_status IS NULL THEN 1 END) as down_interfaces, COUNT(CASE WHEN line_status = 'up' THEN 1 END) as up_interfaces, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN line_status != 'up' OR line_status IS NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as down_pct FROM v_interfaces v JOIN latest l ON v.snapshot_id = l.ls GROUP BY device_name ORDER BY down_interfaces DESC;
